# Release 1.24 — Stance on portfolio

**Status:** Outline — freeze when 1.23 ships  
**Milestone:** `1.24`  
**Parent strategy:** [Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md](../Nivesh_Product_Requirements_and_Roadmap_v1.2.md)  
**Architecture source of truth:** [../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md](../superpowers/specs/2026-11-11-wealth-orbit-architecture-evaluation-design.md)  
**Rule:** Do not edit this file to mark done or change scope after `Approved for freeze`. Status → GitHub only.

---

## Outcome

Signed-in users see **holding-level stance** on Portfolio / morning inbox, including a portfolio-aware overlay such as **“Hold existing position / Avoid as new buy”** when concentration or cost-basis context warrants it. Overlay rules remain **deterministic** and compose on top of L1 instrument stance (1.23) without a second secret scoring system.

---

## Locked decisions

| Decision | Choice | Agent implication |
|----------|--------|-------------------|
| Base label | Always start from 1.23 instrument L1 | Do not reimplement stock/fund scorecards here |
| Overlay | Rules using portfolio context | User-specific; store/compute in Portfolio + Stance collaboration |
| Storage of results | Private store (SQLite) for per-user stance history/overlays | Multi-user ready |
| MTM | Prefer 1.11 values for concentration % | If MTM missing, use cost weights with honest labeling |
| Labels | May use `reduce` in overlay when documented | Keep enum consistent with 1.23 |
| Chat | Not in this release | 1.27 consumes these fields later |

### Overlay examples (normative intent, exact thresholds in code)

- Instrument L1 = `avoid` but user already holds → show `hold` or `reduce` for **existing**, and `avoid` for **new buy**.  
- Position weight above concentration cap → suggest `reduce` even if L1 is `hold`/`buy`.  
- Missing quotes → overlay confidence down; never invent gain.

Return shape extends 1.23 contract with:

- `portfolio_context`: `{ portfolio_id, holding_weight, cost_basis, mtm_value?, overlay_label, overlay_evidence[] }`  
- `label` for “new money” vs `overlay_label` for “existing position” must be clearly distinguished in UI.

## Foundation

- [ ] Batch stance for all holdings in a portfolio (no N+1 scrape; use 1.23 engine + Tier A)  
- [ ] Overlay rules module with version id included in payload  
- [ ] Authz: only portfolio owner sees overlays  
- [ ] Honest empty when L1 unavailable for a holding

## Out of scope

- Tax-lot optimization, wash-sale logic  
- Automatic rebalancing orders  
- LLM narrative (1.26)  
- Strategy merge (1.25)  
- Broker execution

## Exit

Portfolio page shows per-holding stance and overlay; morning inbox can list stance-related attention items; all labels trace to 1.23 + documented overlay rules with versions.

---

## Agent planning instructions

1. Call StanceEngine L1; add overlay in a separate pure function — do not fork stock/fund formulas.  
2. Keep user-specific results out of shared `market_data` unless carefully read-only cache with user_id (prefer SQLite).  
3. Require 1.23; soft-depend on 1.11/1.22.  
4. One issue per checkbox; milestone `1.24`.
